messages:
Priya: Quick async standup — short check on roadmap items for the embed cache rollout. What I did: opened PR #482 (spec updates). Blockers: waiting perf numbers from eng-runtime. Today: triage CRs and finalize canary config.
Alex: Pulled the PR, left a couple comments on the TTL section. I can run the staging perf script — tag me when ready.
Priya: Thanks — Alex, please run staging with the 16-token median workload. Target p50 < 55ms.
Dani: FYI infra scheduled node maintenance 11:30-12:00 PT. That could hit the canary window. Suggest moving smoke to 12:15.
Priya: OK moving smoke to 12:15. Can someone update the rollout doc and call out the maintenance window?
Sam: I can update the doc now and add a checklist item to pause auto-scaling during the smoke. Also pinging QA for prompt-set approval.
Priya: Thanks Sam. @Lina can you run the eval set and share failures?
Lina: On it — running evals now, ETA ~11:45 PT. I'll paste a short failure summary here.
Alex: Quick run on staging: p50 62ms, p95 190ms with current TTL. Trying a couple batching tweaks and will re-run.
Priya: Good data — if tuning drops p50 under 55 we keep current config; otherwise we'll flip to more aggressive KV cache.
Dani: When we shift smoke to 12:15 remember to pause autoscaler to prevent instance churn. @eng-infra please ack.
eng-bot: Reminder: scheduled node maintenance in infra at 2026-03-17T11:30-12:00 PT.
Priya: Plan for today: 1) Sam updates rollout doc + pause autoscaler checklist; 2) Alex re-runs perf after tuning; 3) Lina posts eval failures; 4) I'll merge PR #482 if no major blockers after 12:30. Ping here with results. :thumbsup:
Alex: Will re-run and report by 11:40 PT.
Lina: Eval results posted — two prompt failures (edge-case truncation). Sharing short list in the PR comments.
Sam: Doc updated and autoscaler pause steps added. Linked in the rollout playbook.
Priya: Great — thanks everyone. If tuning doesn't hit targets we'll talk fallback plan in the 12:00 async slot.
